vals: Curator lorebook 1=The Pawnbroker of Forgotten Days
Lore-select lorebook 1=The Pawnbroker of Forgotten Days

House rule 1=Memory is currency: every memory taken, pawned, traded or returned must be described as a concrete, physical thing (a jar, a ledger entry, a sealed vial, a stamped chit) with a stated price in years.
House rule 2=A memory returned is never identical to the one taken.
House rule 3=Whenever a memory changes hands, the story must show how it was altered.
House rule 4=Debts in this city are settled in years of life or memory, never in coin alone; coin can only buy the right to negotiate a debt.
House rule 5=The queen's secret — that she chose to pawn her own childhood — stays hidden until the palace confrontation beat; no character may state or imply it before then.
House rule 6=The pawnbroker never recovers a memory for free: every gain of recovered_memory must cost coin, leverage, or a piece of the pawnbroker's own past.
House rule 7=The Archivist never lies about the ledger, but may refuse to answer.
House rule 8=The Memory Broker never gives information without naming a price first.
